answer: Treat every claim as a hypothesis and draw a jury only when its members span different funding histories, while a duplicate submission forfeits the entire bond. The cipher of each submission is checked against the archive before the vote counts. If honesty costs 30 POA of compute per task, the cheapest viable attack must cost more than that, and a mirror of clones at 10 POA each only works until the first forfeiture, which puts the zenith of that farm one replay away from zero.
